### A Vision of Heaven
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/a-vision-of-heaven-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-march-12-2018.html
Passage: Revelation 21:4
Points:
- Human minds are too limited to fully grasp the infinite beauty of heaven.
- God promises an eternity completely free from fear, pain, sorrow, and death.
- The supreme joy of heaven is being in the personal presence of Jesus Christ.

### The Perfected Kingdom
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-3-2026.html
Passage: Revelation 21:5
Points:
- History is linear and directed toward a definite climax centered on Christ.
- Jesus will completely fulfill God's redemption plan and make all things new.
- Knowing the glorious ending enables Christians to walk through life with confidence and joy.
